---
title: "Double-Angle Identity Illustrations"
author: "Anthony Morciglio"
date: "11/16/2025"
output: html_document
---

```{r, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)

# Create theta values
theta <- seq(-pi, pi, length.out = 1000)

# Compute functions
sin_theta <- sin(theta)
cos_theta <- cos(theta)
tan_theta <- tan(theta)

# Double-angle identities
sin_double <- 2 * sin_theta * cos_theta
cos_double <- cos(theta)^2 - sin(theta)^2
tan_double <- (2 * tan_theta) / (1 - tan_theta^2)

# Data frame for plotting
df <- data.frame(
  theta = theta,
  sin_theta = sin_theta,
  sin_double = sin_double,
  cos_theta = cos_theta,
  cos_double = cos_double,
  tan_theta = tan_theta,
  tan_double = tan_double
)

### Plot 1: Sine Double Angle
ggplot(df, aes(x = theta)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = sin_theta), color = "blue", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_line(aes(y = sin_double), color = "red", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(title = "Double Angle Identity for Sine",
       y = "Function Value",
       color = "Legend") +
  theme_minimal()

### Plot 2: Cosine Double Angle
ggplot(df, aes(x = theta)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = cos_theta), color = "blue", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_line(aes(y = cos_double), color = "red", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(title = "Double Angle Identity for Cosine",
       y = "Function Value",
       color = "Legend") +
  theme_minimal()

### Plot 3: Tangent Double Angle
# Restrict plot to avoid vertical asymptotes
df2 <- df[abs(df$tan_theta) < 10 & abs(df$tan_double) < 10, ]

ggplot(df2, aes(x = theta)) +
  geom_point(aes(y = tan_theta), color = "blue", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(y = tan_double), color = "red", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(title = "Double Angle Identity for Tangent",
       y = "Function Value",
       color = "Legend") +
  theme_minimal()
```
